finding.summary: Global _savers dictionary caches SqliteSaver instances indefinitely with no cleanup. While limited to 3 repeats (3 connections), in long-running processes this could accumulate connections if the pattern is reused.
finding.fix: Add a cleanup function to close all savers, or use weakref.WeakValueDictionary to allow garbage collection when savers are no longer referenced.

label: false_positive
label_reason: one SqliteSaver per repeat (k of them) for the life of a Promptfoo run; nothing reuses the process afterwards.
notes: finding.line moved 17 -> 29: at raised_sha fee8a9a the module-level _savers dictionary is at agent_provider.py:29 (17 is `import sqlite3`); the review cited the wrong line.
